expectation_basis: Three existing language records, two CN pairings and one shared QCP source. Seven legal empty-list signed-int payload cases are preserved exactly; five reviewed nonempty topologies cover singleton, head with successor, tail with predecessor, interior neighbors and interior with two successors. All correct-body semantic expectations are PASS in both inline and modular strategies; actual native states remain separately recorded. Annotated CN has a weaker payload postcondition and orig.broken has no add contract. Equal QCP source and binds are executed once per strategy/mode and referenced by both CN pairings.
cn_trust_qualification: Annotated original add core untrusted; allocation/free external contracts assumed. Unannotated orig.broken has no corresponding input/output ownership contract and cannot be counted as contract-checked.

qcp_execution_deduplication.cost_counting: Count each actual shared QCP execution and all its attempts once; preserve references from both CN pairing records. Separate Fulminate execution remains required for each CN variant/input.
qcp_execution_deduplication.condition: Both pairings have the same QCP variant, function, case IDs and complete binds. Different source, bind, function, dependency or execution configuration identities must not share an execution.
